title: Mogya a Edi Kan a Wohwie gui wɔ Ahoɔyaw mu
intro: Fa w’adwene bu adesamma mfiase, bere a na wiase nyinaa yɛ abusua biako no. Wohwɛ sɛdeɛ wɔde afɔrebɔdeɛ mmienu si Allah anim — baako gye tom, baako nso a wɔpo. Ahoɔyaw gye ntini wɔ koma mu, na wɔde abufuw bɔ ahunahuna bi asereserew. Nea edi hɔ no begyaw agyiraehyɛde wɔ abakɔsɛm mu daa, na anomaa ketewaa mpo bɛyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo.
clues: Meka abusua a edi kan koraa wɔ asase so no ho.
Mede afɔrebɔdeɛ bi maa Allah, nanso wɔannye me deɛ no wɔ berɛ a na afɔrebɔ foforɔ no.
Mede ahoɔyaw kasae na mihunahunaa me sɛ mekum obi.
Meyɛɛ awudi a ɛnteɛ a edi kan wɔ asase so.
Mihuu ɔkraman bi sɛ ɔrebɔ fam de akyerɛ me sɛnea mede funu bi besie.
Wogyaw me a anuonyam ahyɛ me ma na mekyɛɛ wɔn a wɔahwere ade wɔ nea me nsa ayɛ no ho.

identity.label: Meyɛ Henanom?
options: Qabil (Kain), Adam babarima
Samiri, ɔyɛ nantwi ba no
Namrud, otirimɔdenfoɔ a ɔne Ibrahim gyee akyinnyeɛ
Asar, abosom yɛfo
Kan'an, Nuh ba a nsuo faa no

Sikakɔkɔɔ nantwi ba a wɔreyɛ de asom

trial.answer: Onua bi kum esiane ahoɔyaw nti bere a wɔapow afɔrebɔ akyi

outcome.answer: Ɔbɛyɛɛ obi a onu ne ho na ɔkaa wɔn a wɔhweree no ho

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
